# Fixture Hub Shared

Two modes across one packet.

| Mode | Packet | Use it for |
|------|--------|------------|
| `fixture-shared-mode` | `fixture-shared-mode` | The base fixture mode |
| `fixture-shared-mode-parent` | `fixture-shared-mode` | The parent fixture mode that shares the base packet |
